questions.subject: Distinguish clinical obesity and preclinical adiposity using organ function instead of BMI alone
questions.falsifier: A predeclared external cohort shows no incremental organ-health prediction beyond BMI-only baseline
counter_tests: calibrate by age and sex without attributing causality
avoid assuming coexisting dysfunction is caused by adiposity

questions.subject: Understand biological and environmental determinants of durable obesity treatment response and weight recurrence
mechanisms: long-term neuroendocrine appetite and energy balance regulation
questions.falsifier: Predeclared biological factors fail to predict post-treatment outcomes in independent longitudinal cohorts
counter_tests: separate placebo-controlled treatment from observational continuation
track discontinuation and long-term adverse events
compare care access across resource settings
